# adf-markdown

> Converts Atlassian Document Format JSON to compact, safe Markdown for a core node subset, with canonical normalization. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u063-adf-markdown`, package `adfmarkdown`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, API summary, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and not defended
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): what the tests cover and how to run them
